discovered_after: Completed fixed baseline and fine-tune evaluation, during fine-tune error-overlay inspection

confirmed_examples.finding: Full-resolution visual inspection shows multiple cattle. The correctly named source VOC and YOLO files both contain no objects. An empty annotation file is not evidence of an empty scene.

additional_check: Inspected all 88 downloaded VOC files for object-count agreement with YOLO. One includes an extra non-cow red_squirrel object; cow counts agree. The confirmed missing-label case is present in both formats, so switching formats does not resolve it.
scope: Targeted visual audit, not complete relabeling. The prevalence of missing annotations and effects on training/calibration are unknown.
metrics_interpretation: Retain frozen scores as agreement with supplied annotations. Do not treat precision, count error, negative-scene false alarms, or correction-work estimates as verified real-world accuracy or workload. Recall is recall of supplied annotations only. Human scores against these references are provisional too.
next_validation: Independently annotate a fresh small flight-separated test set, resolve ambiguous animals and visibility rules, audit training/calibration labels, then rerun a newly frozen experiment. Do not selectively remove troublesome test images or tune on relabeled evaluation images.
